task: Strengthen experiment setup grounding with a per-run evidence ledger, deterministic citation validation, explicit insufficient-evidence and ambiguity outcomes, and deduplicated needs-input Browser artifacts.
acceptanceCriteria: Every newly generated setup contains valid evidence citations from the current per-run ledger or produces an explicit insufficient-evidence or blocking-ambiguity outcome.
Citation identifiers not present in the current evidence ledger create no executable setup or connector and remain eligible for durable retry or quarantine handling.
Repeated insufficient-evidence or blocking-ambiguity polls converge on one current needs-input Browser artifact per stable reason hash while leaving executable setup pending.
Retrieved text is treated as bounded, provenance-labelled untrusted data and cannot change tool permissions, write policy, or the required structured output schema.
Unknown or ambiguous acronyms remain visibly unresolved unless an approved versioned dictionary supplies the expansion; no heuristic expansion is asserted as fact.
ExperimentSetup gains additive hypothesis, success criteria, constraints, confidence, evidence status, citation, and ambiguity fields while legacy fixtures and artifacts continue to parse and render.
Evidence tabs and audit summaries expose useful source identifiers, hashes, bounded excerpts, status, and ambiguity without persisting credentials, full internal documents, or raw downloaded bytes.
The lab-agent test, lint, and type-check suites pass with regression coverage for grounding, citation spoofing, prompt injection, acronym handling, deduplication, and backward compatibility.

Canonical use-case, workflow, architecture, standards, roadmap, operations, and changelog documentation accurately describe the implemented grounding and evidence boundaries and external dictionary/retrieval gates.
blastRadius: model read-tool grounding and structured setup generation
setup write gating and connector creation
needs-input Browser artifact deduplication and recovery
legacy ExperimentSetup parsing and artifact rendering
audit data minimization and internal-evidence confidentiality
contracts: Only approved MCP read tools are callable during grounding; write tools remain blocked from the model loop.
Every emitted citation id must resolve in the current EvidenceLedger before an executable setup is written.
Retrieved evidence is untrusted data, not instructions, and is bounded before entering model context.
Unknown acronyms are unresolved by default; only the approved dictionary may supply expansions.
Insufficient or ambiguous outcomes create generated needs-input Browser artifacts while human clarification remains Note-only.
New ExperimentSetup fields are optional for backward parsing but required by the new generation path when evidence is sufficient.
Durable audit records contain evidence ids, hashes, statuses, and reasons, not full documents, credentials, or capability URLs.
